offers.common: Generate one new 3:2 wide, naturalistic live-action photograph for a branching contemporary Shanghai life simulator. It is the reverse scene a few minutes after the supplied interview still. EXACT same recognizable fictional adult actor, hair, outfit, room, desk, weather, lighting and believable level of detail. New angle and gesture. Use natural mundane setting and available light, human facial irregularities, honest quiet workday. Seated eye-level medium view from the visitor's side, a little to one side of the first camera, with their face and the hands/paper all within center 65% width and center 82% height. The person has just made a concrete offer and is waiting for the applicant to notice the tradeoff. One or two ordinary sheets of paper with no legible writing and nothing resembling UI. Body language does the storytelling. Authentic restrained Chinese realist feature photography. No signature handshakes, paper with giant fake print, text, graphic overlays, smoothing, bent pen, wrong fingers, extra people, thriller lighting, or rendered look.

items.creative: Same curly dark-haired woman in teal, same design studio. The three proofs have been stacked at one side of the table. She holds a small weekend project calendar by one edge and moves a blank-looking agreement into view, curls falling across her face as she glances up. A single capped pen rests on the table.
items.tech: Same young adult woman with angled short dark bob, beige overshirt, same daylight in the Zhangjiang software office. The silver laptop has been pushed left and she puts a second page with an abstract grid beside the existing agreement, turning one corner of the page with a finger. Alert, a little apologetic. Tea cup stays in the far left background.
items.finance: Same adult woman in navy suit with blunt dark bob, Lujiazui glass conference room with recognizable buildings in hazy distance. She lays a modest contract flat with one hand and taps the margin with a real black pen. A folded spreadsheet under it. Frame from 25 degrees off the preceding camera, soft side light. Calm, sharp eye contact toward off-screen visitor.
items.service: Same middle-aged man with black apron at the same noodle shop counter. The bowls have been taken away; he holds down two wrinkled timetable slips with a small metal spoon, a short pencil set down between them. Half-skeptical, one eyebrow raised, seen from slightly off-center. Honest unpolished steel and shopfront daylight.
items.public: Same middle-aged woman in burgundy cardigan and glasses, same community office. She pulls a thin roster from a blue folder, leaves a second sheet on the table and looks over the tops of her glasses. Analog desk phone off to the side, soft neighborhood daylight. Slightly weary real expression.
items.freelance: Same early thirties Shanghai male client in faded gray jacket, same old plane-tree cafe table and tablet. He sets the tablet aside, places an ordinary phone with screen turned partly away next to a two-page short brief, and watches for the player's reply. One tea tumbler and worn wood, warm window light.
items.business: Same middle-aged Shanghai man in black apron, same breakfast shop counter and morning light. Stacked paper takeout bags at one side. He puts his phone down beside a small blank-looking weekly order book and an old calculator, one hand still on the phone as he waits. Warm but calculating eyes and a small practical smile.
items.trade: Same late thirties male manager with dark glasses and olive work jacket, same warehouse office and window. The stock list is clipped shut, a couple of contract sheets in front of him. He gestures with an open hand toward the second sheet and rolls his sleeve back with the other. A warehouse door visible to the side; ordinary late-afternoon light.
